UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User preferences, passcode hash, reminder schedule, and bookmarked scripture references.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this profile.

displayName.description: Display name shown inside the app.

themeMode.description: Preferred light or dark reading theme.

nightReadingWarmth.description: Whether warm low-glare reading tint is enabled in dark mode.

passcodeEnabled.description: Whether the 4-digit privacy passcode lock is active.

passcodeHash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the salted 4-digit passcode.

passcodeSalt.description: Random salt used to hash the user passcode.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether gentle daily reminders are enabled.

morningReminderTime.description: Morning scripture reminder time in HH:MM 24h format.

eveningReminderTime.description: Evening night-watch reminder time in HH:MM 24h format.

bookmarkedVerseIds.description: Bounded list of up to 100 bookmarked daily verse identifiers.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

PrayerEntry.title: PrayerEntry
PrayerEntry.description: A private prayer journal entry tied to a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the author.

title.description: Short heading for the prayer entry.

verseRef.description: Optional scripture reference linked to the prayer.

answered.description: Whether the user marked this prayer as answered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last edit.

AccountabilityCheckin.title: AccountabilityCheckin
AccountabilityCheckin.description: Daily purity progress and accountability reflection metadata (photos remain private on-device in IndexedDB).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

dateKey.description: Calendar day key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

reflection.description: Short personal reflection on the day.

hasLocalPhoto.description: Indicates whether an on-device accountability photo is stored for this date.

photoCaption.description: Short caption describing the visual accountability moment.

urgesResisted.description: Count of temptations paused and overcome during the day (0 to 100).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user settings, hashed passcode config, reminder times, and bookmarked verse IDs.

/users/{userId}/prayers/{prayerId}.description: Private prayer journal entries belonging strictly to {userId}.

/users/{userId}/checkins/{checkinId}.description: Daily accountability check-in records keyed by YYYY-MM-DD belonging strictly to {userId}.
